## Install

**macOS / Linux**
```bash
curl -LsSf https://n-dimitrov.github.io/jtr/install.sh | sh
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**
```powershell
irm https://n-dimitrov.github.io/jtr/install.ps1 | iex
```

Already on 1.2.0 or later? `jtr update` does it. The installer fetches `uv` if needed, then installs this release. The same steps are on the [landing page](https://n-dimitrov.github.io/jtr/). No access to GitHub from your shell? Download the **Source code (zip)** below, extract it, and run the bundled `install.sh` / `install.ps1` — see [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/n-dimitrov/jtr/blob/main/INSTALL.md).

## What's new

**The `/jtr` skill for more agents.** The skill is one `SKILL.md` that Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and OpenCode all read, so jtr can now install it where each of them looks:

| `--agent` | `--global` | project (default) |
|---|---|---|
| `claude` (default) | `~/.claude/skills` (honours `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`) | `.claude/skills` |
| `codex` (alias `agents`) | `~/.agents/skills` | `.agents/skills` |
| `gemini` | `~/.gemini/skills` | `.gemini/skills` |
| `copilot` | `~/.copilot/skills` | `.github/skills` |
| `cursor` | `~/.cursor/skills` | `.cursor/skills` |
| `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/skills` (honours `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`) | `.opencode/skills` |

- `jtr skill install --agent cursor` installs for Cursor; `--global` works with every agent.
- In a terminal, `jtr init` and `jtr skill install` show a numbered menu when `--agent` is omitted. Enter keeps Claude Code.
- `jtr skill update`, `jtr update` and the installer refresh every existing copy for every agent, and still never create one.
- `jtr skill status` gains an `agent` column. Claude Code's two locations are always listed; other agents appear where a copy exists (`--json` lists them all).

**Landing page.** Step 3 has a tab per agent with the install commands and directories for each.

## Behaviour changes

- `jtr init` and `jtr skill install` prompt for the agent when run in a terminal without `--agent`. Under `--json`, with piped stdin, or with `--no-skills` / `--bare`, nothing is prompted and the skill goes to Claude Code as before.
- `jtr init --json` adds `skill_agent` (`null` under `--no-skills`). `jtr skill status --json` and the rows from `skill update` carry an `agent` field.
- The bundled skill text changed, so unedited copies from earlier releases show as `outdated` once and are refreshed by `jtr update` or `jtr skill update`.

## Upgrading

```bash
jtr update
```

No config, cookie, or `.env` change is required.
